attributes.board_name: Junta Examinadora de Profesionales del Trabajo Social de Puerto Rico (Departamento de Estado)

rules.accepted_credit_types: Programs of the Instituto de Educación Continuada (attached to the Colegio de Profesionales del Trabajo Social) or trainings inside or outside the employer certified by that Institute
rules.alternatives: Not required while enrolled in accredited university studies in social work (at least 2 credits passed and still studying); not required for retired professionals not practising or for documented just cause.
rules.audit_note: The Instituto de Educación Continuada certifies compliance yearly to the Junta Examinadora and the Colegio; evidence is presented at renewal.
rules.notes: Every holder of a permanent or provisional licence must complete at least 12 contact hours of continuing education each year (Ley 171-1940, Art. 6). The Puerto Rico Supreme Court (Rivera Ramos v. ELA, 10 June 2024) held compulsory membership in the Colegio unconstitutional; the Junta's Resolution 2024-02 keeps the CE programme administered by the Colegio's Institute subject to the Junta's approval and says the CE provisions of Ley 171 continue to apply.
rules.legal_basis: Ley Núm. 171 de 11 de mayo de 1940, según enmendada, Art. 6 (20 L.P.R.A. § 842)
rules.rule_quote: Toda persona que ejerza la profesión de Trabajo Social en Puerto Rico y posea una licencia permanente o provisional expedida por la Junta Examinadora, deberá cumplir, además, con un mínimo de doce (12) horas-contacto cada año de educación continuada.
